service.description:
Fase 2 mechanism proof: a real ternary (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN) derived-boolean determination, deliberately not reduced to pressure alone. Checks PED 2014/68/EU applicability (Article 1.2 threshold, Article 1.3 real exclusions) - not Annex II category assignment (out of scope, needs real fluid-group/equipment tables).
Fail-closed: if ANY required input (pressureBar, fluidGroup, at least one of volumeLiters/nominalDiameterMm, equipmentType, isAssembly, exclusions) is missing, the outcome is INCOMPLETE and no ProductFeatureAppl is written - the ternary state stays UNKNOWN (absence of both FEAT_PED_APPLICABLE and FEAT_PED_NOT_APPLICABLE), never FALSE. exclusions must be passed explicitly (an empty list is valid - it means the caller considered exclusions and found none - but a missing/null value is not).
This is a MmtCodeDefinedFunction MathModel (MM_PED_APPLICABILITY, see CompliancePedMechanismProofSeedData.xml) - same run-tracking pattern as check#ProductCategoryCompliance, reused as-is.

parameter.name: exclusions
parameter.description: Article 1.3 exclusion codes that apply, e.g. TransportablePressureEquipment, SimplePressureVessel - pass an empty list, not null, when none apply.
